symptom: A dispatched GitHub run (shell_exec, DeepSeek, image, deep research, site build, browser, review) was reported 'not found' even though it existed.
cause: Each run-waiter loop clamped its last sleep to the deadline, then exited on the while-condition WITHOUT a final read, so a run first listed exactly at the deadline was missed.
fix: Check the deadline after each read so there is always one last look; workflowRun also retries dropped/5xx reads until the deadline instead of abandoning the wait.

anchor.needle: there is always one last look

symptom: A tool output of '[GUARDIAN BLOCK] …' was treated as evidence/success instead of a failure (finding J-08).
cause: The failure classifier regex did not match the '[GUARDIAN BLOCK]' prefix.
fix: isToolFailureOutput matches /^\[GUARDIAN (?:BLOCKED?|REJECTED)\]/i, covering BLOCK, BLOCKED and REJECTED.

symptom: Needed the correct Kalshi taker-fee formula so proposal sizing does not under- or over-charge fees.
cause: Fee must follow Kalshi's published general taker schedule, rounded up to the cent.
